title: Rank-Two Complex Refutation of the Bapat-Sunder Conjecture, Exact O(n^3) Cauchy-Binet Spectral Decomposition, and Low-Dimensional Rigidity
abstract: The Bapat-Sunder conjecture (1985) asked whether every Hermitian positive semidefinite (PSD) matrix A satisfies per(A) I_n >= A o adj_per(A) := F_A in the Loewner order, known to hold for n <= 3 and refuted in higher rank over C at n = 7 (Drury 2016) and over R in higher dimension. We resolve the sharp rank-2 Hermitian regime through three exact structural theorems backed by constructive Lean 4.36.0 proofs and zero-float Gaussian-integer certificates. First, we show that F_A 1 = per(A) 1 identically (reducing the conjecture to lambda_max(F_A|_{1^perp}) <= per(A)), prove exact diagonal congruence invariance F_{D A D^*} = |det D|^2 F_A on (CP^1)^n, and establish an exact O(n^3) Cauchy-Binet elementary-symmetric-polynomial Gram factorization F_A = sum_{k=0}^{n-1} k!(n-1-k)! (U_k U_k^* + V_k V_k^*) >= 0 for every rank-2 PSD matrix A = u u^* + v v^*. Second, we establish exact n = 2 rigidity via per(A)||w||^2 - w^* F_A w = |b|^2 |w_1 - w_2|^2 >= 0, prove the exact n = 3 shift-Laplacian identity per(A_0 + t I_3)I_3 - F_{A_0 + t I_3} = (per(A_0)I_3 - F_{A_0}) + t L(|A_0|^{o 2}) reducing 3x3 Hermitian PSD rigidity to rank <= 2 (where F_{A_0}|_{1^perp} collapses to rank 2), derive the exact Fourier spectrum lambda_m = n^2(m-1)!(n-1-m)! r^{2m} on n-th root circulants proving sup_{r>0} lambda_max(F|_{1^perp})/per = (n-1)^{-1/n} < 1 for all n >= 3 (showing symmetry breaking is necessary), and prove exact boundary saturation on real balanced direct sums J_{2m} + z z^T = 2(J_m oplus J_m). Third, we exhibit explicit rank-2 Gaussian-integer complex refutations at n = 8 (per = 573,191,776,350,720, gap +648,442,380,656,640, Rayleigh ratio 1.01166), an ultra-compact s = 1 counterexample A_9 = J_9 + z_9 z_9^* at n = 9 (per = 6,088,320, gap +11,572,992, ratio 1.00433), a general n = 9 witness (per = 44,125,969,104,000, gap +28,015,262,426,880, ratio 1.00765), and a high-margin n = 10 counterexample (per = 120,756,089,364,480, gap +1,147,005,482,158,080, ratio 1.08557, spectral ratio 1.09508), each directly machine-checked over Z[i] inside Lean 4.36.0 and independently cross-verified against direct Gray-code Ryser permanents.
